sloka: इदं भुङ्क्ष्व महाराज प्रीतो यदशना वयम् ।यदन्न: पुरुषो भवति तदन्नास्तस्य देवता: ॥ २.१०२.३०॥
transliteration: idaṁ bhuṅkṣva mahārāja prīto yadaśanā vayam ।yadanna: puruṣo bhavati tadannāstasya devatā: ॥ 2.102.30॥

translations.english: O great king, we offer you such food as we partake now. Be pleased to accept it. For, his gods are offered the food a man takes.
